perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

enhanced.name: Surplus
enhanced.description: Substantially increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

enhanced.name: No Distractions
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

enhanced.name: Compulsive Reloader
enhanced.description: Grants greatly increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Sleight of Hand
enhanced.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
enhanced.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideshot
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Clown Cartridge
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.description: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

enhanced.name: Adaptive Munitions
enhanced.description: This weapon adapts its damage output to be more effective against energy shields that don't match its damage type. Improves damage increase.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

enhanced.name: Turnabout
enhanced.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

enhanced.name: High-Impact Reserves
enhanced.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Box Breathing
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.
